title: REQUIRE_FIPS checks ops->fips_gate on the returned provider, closing TOCTOU
description: In ioctl_init(), after crypto2dev_lookup_algo() returns the ops pointer, the REQUIRE_FIPS check is: 'if (state->require_fips && \!ops->fips_gate)'. It does NOT re-call crypto2dev_fips_provider_loaded() for this decision. The code comment at this site is explicit: 'Check ops->fips_gate rather than re-reading fips_provider_loaded() — the latter is a separate atomic read that can race with a concurrent provider load between lookup and this check (TOCTOU). FIPS providers always set fips_gate; non-FIPS providers leave it NULL.' The check is on the specific ops struct that was already returned by lookup — the same ops that will be used for the session. If a FIPS provider were loaded after lookup but before a re-read of fips_provider_loaded(), the check would incorrectly conclude FIPS is active even though the selected ops are from a non-FIPS provider. Checking ops->fips_gate directly is both correct and race-free. A reviewer might simplify to 'just call fips_provider_loaded() again — it's cleaner.' That reintroduces the TOCTOU window.
